name: Paratwada–Chandur Bazar District road

tollInfo.note: District roads in India are not tolled.

significance: MDR 3518, Paratwada–Chandur Bazar District road, crosses the border between Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra. A state road that runs through more than one state has no single owner — MP PWD and Maharashtra PWD each maintain the stretch inside their own state, so which department to contact depends on where along the road you are.
